text:
Aisha: Quick ping  slight schedule shuffle for today's all-hands. Start moves +3 minutes to 16:03 PT so Ops can finish a hotfix. Sorry for the last-minute change.
Rob: +3 is fine. What was the hotfix?
Aisha: Recorder could lose the last 2-3s of a segment when slide auto-advances. Ops added a finalize hook to seal segments on slide change.
Sam: Can we enable an emergency fallback that records directly to S3 if the live edge disconnects? Last time we lost fragments.
OpsBot: action: enable s3_atomic_fallback=true for group=all-hands. result=OK (2.6s)
StreamBot: recorder: dual_persist(local,S3) enabled for session 1765912345.
Nora: Presenters: join the prep room 8m early if you're playing local audio/video. We'll map inputs.
Liam: For agenda: can we sneak a 6-min live Q&A after roadmap? Folks keep DMing me about priority items.
Aisha: Good call. Adding a 6-min Q&A after roadmap; if we run out of time we'll collect leftover Qs in this thread and answer offline.
Sam: Recording note for leadership: avoid the "share system audio" toggle in slide share  it duplicates channels and breaks the stitcher. Use the DeckAudio channel we provide.
OpsBot: preflight: recorder-0 cpu=14% mem=46% disk=59% jitter=3ms segments_ok
Rob: Mic-checks: Rob here  say "redwood live mic check"
Liam: Got you loud and clear.
Aisha: If anyone sees buffering during the live, try a soft restart on the recorder container and ping #eng-sre: `kubectl -n recorder rollout restart deploy/recorder` (ping before).
Nora: I'll be in the prep room mapping USB mics and testing embedded video. DM me your device model if it's non-standard.
Aisha: Thanks all. Drop any urgent Qs for leadership here and I'll surface them in the live Q&A. See you shortly :slightly_smiling_face:
